device.model: Mini 4K UHD S2X (System ID 80000A00, v1.0.38 EMU build)
device.type: DVB-S2X 4K UHD H.265/HEVC satellite receiver with Conax CA card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.board: 80000A00 (bootloader version "M2661A 1.0.1", 8 MB SPI flash, ALi S3922 / C3702 / CAP210 ARMv7-A platform)
device.soc: ALi M2661A / S3922 (ARMv7-A CPU, get_clock_3922 / get_clock_cap210 / get_clock_3702, DECV_HEVC_0/1, NIM_C3501h_0 / NIM_S3505_1)
device.family: M3801 (chips/m3801.py, NCRC chunk container only; CPU is ARMv7-A rather than MIPS32)

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (M2661A 1.0.1), maincode(AV) 0x078000 (80000A001038, LZMA -> 16.06 MB), default_lang 0x53FD00, cipluskey 0x53FF80, countryband 0x54FF80, img_webserver 0x557F80, html_webserver 0x5B7F80, logo_user 0x657F80, logo_menu 0x667F80, logo_radio 0x687F80, logo_boot 0x6A7F80, patch 0x6CFF80, defaultdb(PRC) 0x6F0000, userdb(64+64) 0x73FF80

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Mini_4K_S2X_1.0.38_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Does not boot on the MIPS32 simulator (run_dump_mini_4k_s2x_arm_layout.py): although the 8 MB image uses ALi's standard NCRC chunk chain (magic 0x23010010 at 0x000000, HEAD descriptor at 0x258, LZMA-compressed maincode(AV) at 0x078000 decompressing to 16.06 MB), the ALi M2661A / S3922 ("ALI_S3922", "get_clock_3922", "get_clock_cap210") is an ARMv7-A 4K UHD SoC rather than MIPS32.  Its boot-ROM payload at 0x800 starts with an 8-word ARMv7 exception vector table (0xEA000006, 0xEAFFFFFE, 0xEA00004D, ...) followed at 0x820 by mrc p15, #0, r0, c1, c0, #0 (0xEE110F10, reading CP15 SCTLR).

desc: Amiko Mini 4K UHD S2X (System ID 80000A00) firmware v1.0.38 EMU for the 4K UHD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2X satellite receiver on the ALi M2661A / S3922 ARMv7-A SoC with 8 MB SPI flash.
Packages an ARMv7-A bootloader ("M2661A 1.0.1") and ALi SDK 4.0la maincode(AV) inside ALi's traditional NCRC flash chunk container.
